notes: Carries /Perms /UR3 usage rights granting /Form FillIn, /EF Create, Delete, and Modify, and /Signature Modify. Under spec 7.3 (W-67, W-87) a fill, an attachment edit, or a signature into an existing empty signature field keeps /UR3; a metadata write or a signature into a new field removes it in the same revision.

Writer quirk (G2 corpus finding D1, tolerated under W-66): the embedded file's Flate stream ends one byte before /Length, which counts the LF before endstream (ISO 32000-1 7.3.8.1 excludes it). The library found the Adler-32 only in the last four bytes of the stream data and failed with a false checksum error; it now also looks in front of a final CR, LF, or CR LF. qpdf, pypdf, and Python zlib decode the same 15,003 bytes.

G2 corpus finding Q1, fixed under W-66: the /EmbeddedFiles name-tree key is UTF-16LE without a byte-order mark (a�c�c�...). A name-tree key is a string, not necessarily a text string (ISO 32000-1 7.9.6), so the library no longer requires one: a key that is not text names the attachment by its file specification (/UF, then /F), here FAA_Form_8710-1_.pdf.accreport.html, qpdf's preferred name. pypdf lists the bytes under that name.
